name: Stripe Payments
description: Accept one-time payments and subscriptions with Stripe Checkout + a webhook handler for billing events.

requiredSecrets.name: STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: Used by the frontend Stripe.js client

postInstallNotes:
1. Mount the webhook router BEFORE `express.json()` so the raw body is preserved.
2. Add a Stripe webhook endpoint in the Dashboard pointing at `/stripe/webhook` and copy the signing secret into `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.
3. Create products + prices in Stripe and pass the `price_…` id into `createCheckoutSession`.
